description: Normative classification of every GitHub answer the event build handles, restating PERSIST-008, -010, -015, -016 and -024 with the answer forms recorded so far. Each row says how the class is detected (never by HTTP status alone where GitHub gives a status several meanings), the typed error of interfaces IF41-ERRORS, the state-machine transition, what the user sees, the retry policy and its maximum, reconciliation, recovery and the bound tests that prove it. The provider-conformance task T18 records the live forms; a form not in this matrix is GH-UNKNOWN-OUTCOME for a mutation and a failed read otherwise until the matrix is amended through the coordinator.

classes.detection: HTTP 401 on any request (bad, expired or revoked token). No other class uses 401.
classes.transition: SM-SAVE CredentialRefused (T-S18); SM-CONNECTION AuthFailed (T-N04); SM-LOAD LoadRejected (T-L04)
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'GitHub refused the credential; your changes are kept in this tab.' Action: Reconnect (PERSIST-031-O22).
classes.recovery: Reconnect with a new credential (re-authentication keeping work is proposed in ODR-V4-04)

classes.detection: HTTP 403 with no rate-limit evidence (x-ratelimit-remaining is not 0, no retry-after header, message names neither a rate limit nor abuse) and, for GraphQL, an error of type FORBIDDEN whose message is not the moved-head form; or HTTP 404 on the repository endpoint during Connect, where GitHub hides repositories the token cannot read.
nonStatusEvidence: message names no rate limit or abuse
404: repository or branch access not confirmed by Connect
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'This credential cannot write to the repository; your changes are kept in this tab.' Retry is not offered.
classes.recovery: Connect with a credential that has contents write (PF-015-O3); write permission is never inferred from a read (DEC-R7-001)

classes.detection: HTTP 403 or 429 with x-ratelimit-remaining: 0; x-ratelimit-reset gives the reset time.
classes.transition: SM-SAVE ProviderRefused (T-S17); during reconciliation the read counts as ReconcileReadFailed (T-S29)
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'GitHub's rate limit was reached; try again after <reset time>. Your changes are kept in this tab.' Retry after the reset.
classes.retry: no automatic mutation retry; a reconciliation read counts against its three automatic reads
classes.reconciliation: an unknown outcome stays Unknown until a read succeeds

classes.class: Secondary rate limit or abuse detection
classes.detection: HTTP 403 or 429 with a retry-after header, or a message that mentions a secondary rate limit, 'too quickly' or abuse detection; GraphQL errors of type RATE_LIMITED. Rehearsal 7 observed the 403 form during concurrent live writers (KD-020).
nonStatusEvidence: message: secondary rate limit, 'too quickly' or abuse
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'GitHub asked us to slow down; try again in <retry-after> seconds. Your changes are kept in this tab.' Never worded as a permission problem.

classes.detection: GraphQL response with errors whose type is STALE_DATA, or whose message has the form 'is at <oid> but expected <oid>' (returned with type FORBIDDEN; observed live in Rehearsal 7, KD-022), or 'Expected branch to point to <oid>'. Classified from the error content, never from the HTTP status (GraphQL answers 200).
nonStatusEvidence: graphql FORBIDDEN message 'is at <oid> but expected <oid>'
classes.transition: SM-SAVE StaleHeadUnrelated (T-S14/T-S15) or StaleHeadSameInvestigation (T-S16) after a fresh head read and file comparison
classes.userVisible: Saving continues during an automatic rebase; Conflict only when the investigation's own files differ (PERSIST-011).
classes.retry: automatic rebase after a fresh head read
classes.recovery: Rebase (unrelated) or the three conflict actions (same investigation)

classes.detection: REST 422; GraphQL errors whose type is UNPROCESSABLE or an input-validation type other than STALE_DATA (for example a path outside the investigation prefix, which the adapter must refuse before sending, PERSIST-006).
nonStatusEvidence: graphql error type UNPROCESSABLE or input validation other than STALE_DATA
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'GitHub refused the change as invalid: <message>. Your changes are kept in this tab.' Retry is not offered.
classes.recovery: None automatic; the defect is in the change and is reported

classes.detection: REST 404 on a file or ref read at a named commit, after Connect confirmed repository access; GraphQL errors of type NOT_FOUND (branch missing).
nonStatusEvidence: REST 404 on a file or ref read at a named commit after Connect confirmed access
classes.transition: Save path: the investigation was deleted, so StaleHeadSameInvestigation (T-S16) and Conflict (PERSIST-011); conflict re-read: RemoteMissingOrInvalid (T-C03); load: LoadRejected (T-L04)
classes.userVisible: Conflict: 'This investigation was deleted or rewritten on GitHub; your changes are kept.' Load: 'not found in the repository'.
classes.recovery: Conflict actions; export of unsaved commands is proposed in ODR-V4-05

classes.detection: The compare base...head reports status 'diverged' or 'behind' for the expected head, or the expected head commit is no longer reachable (compare 404), during reconciliation.
nonStatusEvidence: compare 404 for the expected head commit
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'The branch history on GitHub was rewritten; nothing is reported as saved. Your changes are kept in this tab.'
classes.recovery: Reload from GitHub after the user decides

classes.detection: The browser reports offline, or fetch fails before the request was sent (NotAnswered FailedBeforeSending). No HTTP status exists.
classes.transition: SM-SAVE FailedBeforeSending (T-S20) -> Offline; SM-NETWORK OfflineObserved (T-W01); a rebase-path read: RebaseReadFailed (T-S57 offline)
classes.userVisible: Offline: 'Your changes exist only in this tab and cannot be saved until the connection returns.' Never Conflict.
classes.retry: none: a save that failed before sending is never retried automatically
classes.recovery: Save again after the connection returns

classes.class: Network failure after sending or timeout
classes.detection: NotAnswered LostAfterSending or TimedOut. For a mutation this is an unknown outcome; for a read it is a failed read.
classes.transition: Mutation: AnswerLost (T-S19) -> Unknown commit outcome. Reconciliation read: ReconcileReadFailed (T-S29). Rebase-path read while online: RebaseReadFailed (T-S59). Read-back: ReadBackReadFailed (T-S58). Conflict re-read: RemoteReadFailed (T-C02)
classes.userVisible: Unknown commit outcome: 'The save may or may not have reached GitHub; checking.' Check again after the automatic reads.
classes.retry: reconciliation reads at least 2, 4 and 8 seconds apart, plus one per offline-to-online change
classes.reconciliation: PERSIST-015: marker and head decide before any resend
classes.recovery: Check again; resend only when reconciliation proves nothing was written

classes.class: Unrecognised or server-error answer to a mutation
classes.detection: HTTP 5xx on the mutation, or a 200 GraphQL answer with an error type the classifier does not recognise. PERSIST-015 counts any unrecognised answer as unknown.
nonStatusEvidence: graphql error type not recognised by the classifier

classes.detection: A 2xx answer whose body does not decode, or lacks a required field (the commit oid of a mutation, the content of a file). For a mutation this is unknown; for a read it is a failed read.
classes.transition: Mutation: AnswerLost (T-S19); read: the read-failure event of the path (T-S29, T-S58, T-S59, T-C02, T-L04)
classes.userVisible: As the path's state: Unknown commit outcome for a mutation, the read's failure state for a read.

classes.detection: The re-read at the returned commit decodes but its bytes differ from the written bytes, or the reconciliation finds this save's marker on a commit whose bytes differ.
nonStatusEvidence: re-read bytes differ from written bytes
marker found on a commit whose bytes differ
classes.userVisible: Save failed: 'GitHub holds different bytes than this save wrote; nothing is reported as saved. Your changes are kept in this tab.'

classes.class: File too large for the contents API
classes.detection: The contents API answers encoding 'none' or a 403 too_large error for a file over 1 MB. Not an error for the user: the read is repeated once through the Git blobs API.
classes.retry: one re-read through the Git blobs API
classes.recovery: Read through the Git blobs API (Rehearsal 7 F11)

classes.detection: A compare answer reports more commits than it lists (GitHub lists at most 250). Not an error: reconciliation pages through the commits after the expected head.
nonStatusEvidence: compare total_commits greater than commits listed
classes.retry: page until every commit after the expected head is read; each page is a reconciliation read
classes.reconciliation: PERSIST-015 needs every commit after the expected head
classes.recovery: Page through the commits list (Rehearsal 7 F10)
